review_method: static read-only source/observed-roster review; no runner execution, truth arrays, inferred trees, installs, GPU or Git

blockers.problem: observations rejects the finalized producer kind/status/fields and requires derived roster SHA to equal the original source roster SHA.
blockers.consequence: Default completed Relate manifest cannot be admitted; actual-ID derived roster cannot satisfy source-byte equality.
blockers.required_change: Admit biological_paths_relate_v1 completed status, replicates/inferred_tree/observed_sample_manifest/completion_provenance/explicit mapping; verify derived roster original source reference and exact observed attributes, while using actual inferred IDs.

blockers.problem: Cache, supervised site labels and all-bin/tract scoring assume a complete 2Mb tree in original coordinates. Producer trees are clipped local coordinates with declared retained centers.
blockers.consequence: Length check fails immediately; removing it alone would shift features/TRAIN targets and extrapolate tails in VAL metrics.
blockers.required_change: Validate sequence_length=coverage_right-coverage_left; query at original center-offset; join inferred sites to original bp0 by adding offset; score exact truth intersections only on declared retained-center bins clipped to coverage, preserving original indexes/2Mb normalization and excluding tails. Tract and endpoint reports must use that scored support.

checked_invariants: Actual source sampler budgets, initial floor stride with 10000/3 overhead, ordered site/query scan, path caps and repeated replacement match source training.py31-35,50-156. Pass bound128 and no-progress failure are explicit adaptations.
Native model is Flatten5x9,Dense512relu,Dropout0.2,Dense6softmax,Adam,categorical_crossentropy,5epochs; batch32/shuffle are documented Keras defaults.
VAL raw predictions are written and hashed before TruthReader; no validation_data, early stopping, checkpoint selection or calibration fitting occurs.
C4 uses p0+p4,p1+p5,p2,p3 before argmax; native confusion predicted rows/truth columns and C4 truth rows/predicted columns.
Exact full-bin truth intersections handle within-bin switches. Covered-support adaptation is required by B2; NLL retains zero-probability infinite span without a floor.
All four observed rosters have pure96 refs, 24 each Ana0/CHG1/WHG2/EHG3; mixed64 and query120 have null classes. Query cohorts present64,BronzeAge16,BAA8,Neo16,Yam16.

Features count declared ancient cohorts, including mixed references and ancient focal self-inclusion, as native source requires; query role controls supervised/predicted rows and pure labels never become query labels.
limitations: No source/runner execution or inferred-tree/label inspection; this is static integration review, not training/metric runtime verification.
